faq.title: For Recruiters & HR
faq.q1: What job roles are you currently targeting?
faq.a1: I am open to Full-Time, Part-Time, Hybrid, or Remote roles as a Creative Designer, Graphic & Brand Designer, Motion Graphics Designer, 2D Animator, or Visual Storyteller.
faq.q2: When are you available to join?
faq.a2: I am available immediately for interviews and onboarding, and can collaborate smoothly with teams in Dhaka (on-site/hybrid) or globally (remote).
faq.q3: Which design and animation tools do you use daily?
faq.a3: My daily production stack includes Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Animate, InDesign, Procreate, CapCut, Blender, and Cinema 4D, along with UI prototyping.
faq.q4: How can HR schedule an interview or review my CV?
faq.a4: You can download my PDF CV directly from the homepage, submit an offer via the Hire Me page, or reach me directly by email (artistantor@gmail.com) or phone/WhatsApp (+880 1872-185776).
